abilities.name: Let the Show Begin♪
abilities.caveat: The 15s Melody Loop isn't drawn, so nothing marks the window in which Normal and Charged hits heal. The periodic active-character regen (about every 5s) isn't shown either.
_curatorNotes: Melody Loop is a duration-bounded self-status on the active character (15s base, terminates on recast), not a spawned entity — per recipe (§3 Behavior field, duration-bounded self-status) it is not authored on summons[]. Reviewer to author the self-buff representation. The Loop enables on-hit healing from Barbara's Normal Attacks (4× on Charged) and periodic active-character HP regen, and applies the Wet status to the bearer.

Melody Loop duration extension (A4 Encore): when active character gains Elemental Orb/Particle, Melody Loop extends by 1s (max +5s total). Fits the `durationExtensions[]` primitive (E5, 2026-05-10) but the matching trigger `onPickup` is not yet a schema primitive.

↻ 2026-08-18: the note above used to close with "Once Melody Loop is authored as a window (currently a duration-bounded self-status, no schema home) and `onPickup` lands…". The FIRST half is dead — **`activeDuration` (SkillAbility, instant branch, 2026-08-14) IS that schema home**. It is exactly the field that retired the nine zero-effect stand-in summons (Layla's Curtain of Slumber, Noelle's Stone Armor), and `resolveActiveDuration` draws the span on the E pill. So `activeDuration: 15` on this skill is an authorable work item today, and it would draw the window the caveat says is missing. ⚠️ It is `activeDuration`, ⛔ never `duration` — a stray `duration` on an instant ability is dead data by design.

⚠️ TWO things `activeDuration` would still NOT buy, so don't expect them: (1) `durationExtensions[]` is declared on Summon and on the STANCE branches only — it is not on the instant branch beside `activeDuration`, so A4 Encore has no host even before the trigger question, and (2) `onPickup` is still not a Trigger at all (grep over src/lib finds zero references, 2026-08-18). Authoring shape once both land: `{ trigger: { type: 'onPickup' }, delta: 1, maxExtensions: 5 }`.

⚠️ And a drawn window is not a GATE: an instant cast's `activeDuration` opens no named state, so no `state` condition could say "Melody Loop active" (`opensState` is on the stance branch; `opensTransientState` is for short post-action windows). The three heals would still render on any Barbara N/CA regardless of loop state — see the last note in this array.
C2 (Vitality Burst) reduces skill cooldown by 15% (32s → 27.2s per gcsim: SetCDWithDelay(32*60*0.85, 3)).

↻ 2026-08-18: the note above used to end "No cooldownModifiers schema exists; reviewer to decide how to model." That is dead — `cooldownModifiers[]` exists on the ability and constellation-gated rungs are WIRED (working examples: Kazuha C1, Amber C4, Flins C1). So a `{ conditions: { type: 'constellation', level: 2 }, ... }` rung on this skill is an authorable work item. ⚠️ Two live limits before authoring: a modifier gated on TEAM COMPOSITION is silently skipped (`applyModifiers` passes no ConditionContext), and the Team Builder prints raw `ability.cooldown`, so Compare would keep showing 32s where the planner shows 27.2s.

Skill fires 2 Hydro droplet hits at gcsim frames 42 and 78 during the cast animation (before Melody Loop activates at frame 3). These are attack-tagged hits during casting, not modeled separately here.

Melody Loop heals authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (three effects). (1) Continuous regeneration → target 'active' (gcsim skill.go barbaraSelfTick heals c.Core.Player.Active()); onCast + duration 15 (Melody Loop base window). TL10 skillhpp[9]=0.072 → 7.2% Max HP + skillhp[9]=847.4773 flat (sidecar 'Continuous Regeneration' col10 '7.20% Max HP+847'). Real cadence is a tick every 5s (barbaraSelfTick re-queues at 5*60f, first tick at skillCDStart=3f); the schema has no periodic-self-tick trigger without a summon (Melody Loop is a self-status, not a summon per the note above), so it renders on the cast — see caveat.

(2) On-Normal-hit heal → target 'team' (gcsim attack.go cb Heal Target:-1 = all party members); onHit abilityType 'normal'. TL10 prochpp[9]=0.0135 → 1.35% Max HP + prochp[9]=158.902 flat (sidecar 'HP Regeneration Per Hit' col10 '1.35% Max HP+159'). Fires once per Normal Attack while barbSkillKey (Melody Loop) is active.

(3) On-Charged-hit heal → target 'team' (gcsim charge.go cb Heal Target:-1, Src = 4×(prochpp×MaxHP+prochp)); onHit abilityType 'charged'. 4× the per-hit value → 5.4% Max HP + 635.608 flat. Kit: 'Charged Attack generates 4 times the amount of healing.'

Melody-Loop gating: all three heals only occur while the 15s Loop is active, but no schema condition expresses 'Melody Loop active' (it is a self-status, not a summon/named state). The onHit heals therefore render on any Barbara N/CA in the planner regardless of loop state — surfaced via caveat. Healing Bonus (gcsim HealInfo.Bonus = Heal stat) is applied by the renderer, not authored here.
abilities.description:
Summons water droplets resembling musical notes that form a Melody Loop, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and applying the Wet status to them.

Melody Loop
·On hit, Barbara's Normal Attacks heal your own party members and nearby teammates for a certain amount of HP, which scales with Barbara's Max HP.
·On hit, Barbara's Charged Attack generates 4 times the amount of healing.
·Periodically regenerates your own active character's HP.
·Applies the Wet status to the character and to opponents who come in contact with them.
